visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a beige, multi-compartment rolling bag in a bright, modern interior setting. (2) A woman in a striped shirt and dark trousers unpacks numerous grocery items from the bag onto a white table in a kitchen setting with a large white refrigerator. (3) The woman stands in the kitchen, gesturing towards the bag while speaking directly to the camera; the lighting is bright and even. (4) Detailed close-ups of the bag's exterior, focusing on its fabric texture, side pockets, and zippers. (5) A graphic text overlay appears on a white background, listing the product's name, material, and dimensions. (6) The bag is shown fitted onto the footwell floorboard of a light-colored scooter parked outdoors in a driveway. (7) Demonstration of the bag's interior, showing a mesh pocket containing reusable ice packs and a large insulated silver lining. (8) Successive shots of the woman filling the bag with various grocery items like beef packs and milk cartons. (9) The bag's interior is further filled with frozen shrimp bags, boxes of rice burgers, and chicken packs. (10) A wide shot displays the full contents of the shopping trip on the table next to the bag. (11) A large cardboard box of eggs is shown and then placed vertically into the bag's main compartment. (12) The camera focuses on the grey, waterproof inner lining being pulled out slightly to show it's removable. (13) Close-up of the five-wheeled base and the telescoping handle being retracted and used for hand-carrying. (14) Two versions of the bag (grey and beige) are shown together with optional rain covers before a final static shot of the beige bag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice with a friendly, professional tone begins narrating a shopping experience at Costco. Upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop background music (BGM) with a steady drum beat and guitar strumming starts simultaneously. (2) The narration continues at a moderate pace, describing common repurchase items. The BGM maintains a consistent volume and cheerful vibe with electronic synth accents. (3) The narrator's pitch is expressive, shifting as she introduces a specific rolling cart designed for scooters. (4) Faint sounds of plastic rustling are heard as she handles various grocery items. The vocal tone remains informative and encouraging. (5) A distinct soft thud is audible as milk cartons are placed on the table, followed by more plastic crinkling from frozen food bags. The BGM tempo remains at approximately 115 BPM. (6) Continued narration over the steady acoustic music describes the cart's capacity for meat packs and eggs. (7) A sharp mechanical click sound occurs when the telescoping handle of the cart is demonstrated. (8) The voice explains the removable lining of the bag with high articulation clarity. (9) Final summary of features with the music volume slightly increasing in the background before the clip ends.
